comments.body: `ConnectionHost` returns only the container hostname, not the host-mapped CQL port. Since Cassandra's exposed port is dynamically mapped by Testcontainers, passing this value to `gocql.NewCluster` makes the client fall back to port `9042` on the host, which will generally fail to connect. Retrieve `ConnectionPort` as well and pass `host:port` (or use the module's connection-string helper).
